deskyard env restart: restart an environment

Usage: deskyard [-e ENV] env restart [NAME]

Saves that the environment should be running and restarts it, closing
everyone's connections; the server answers at once. Needs full access to it.

Arguments:
  NAME       string      optional  environment name, or SERVER/NAME on another server; default: the chosen environment (-e, else the server's default)

Prints: a confirmation line

Examples:
  deskyard env restart alice

Where: on this machine, talking to the environment's server: SERVER in SERVER/NAME, else the one -e SERVER/ names, else the default server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
